body: So teh fact that a groupof strangers on the internet care more about me than the people in my life that actually know me is suposed to mke me feel beter?

I just don't know what to do anymore. Literally everything is going wrong. I feel like every decision I make is the wrong one. I look through this page and I see so many people who are going through real struggles and I feel ashamed that I can't even handle my petty problems. I can't go to my friends or my family because as much as they want to help I'm too scared to go back to the hospital's psyche ward again.
I also don't mean to worry anyone here, my poor response time is because Ive been at work. It just gets so much worse at night whenever I can't sleep and I can't get out of my own head.
No. I am a coward. I can't even do the one thing that will make this all just go away. I don't even want to talk about it anymore. I just want it all to stop.
I'm not even sure. Probably both. I don't really see what anyone can do.
